stories.title: Federal indictment alleges Albion man faked disabilities for VA payments
stories.summary: Federal prosecutors say the man falsely claimed severe disabilities while collecting VA benefits worth more than $1 million.

stories.title: Buffalo schools review safety measures after 2 weapon-related incidents
stories.summary: An unloaded firearm in a student's backpack and a separate incident involving a knife prompted Buffalo school leaders to take a closer look at security measures.

stories.title: Batavia man avoids felony conviction in case tied to boy's death
stories.summary: More than a year after a deadly house fire on Vine Street, a judge has sentenced Henry Banks to probation on a misdemeanor child endangerment charge.

stories.title: Seneca Nation vows appeal after judge pauses Miami Street project
stories.summary: A judge has temporarily halted the Seneca Nation's planned gas station project in Buffalo, siding with the city's request for a restraining order.

stories.title: New treatment option for Alzheimer's disease
stories.summary: There's now a weekly injection available.

stories.title: Catholic Charities launches mobile food pantry to reach food-insecure communities across WNY
stories.summary: Catholic Charities of Buffalo is taking its food pantry services on the road. They unveiled a 15-foot mobile food pantry that will start servicing the Northtowns.

stories.title: Buffalo school superintendent reacts to rejection of consolidation plan, possibility of fiscal takeover by control board
stories.summary: The city school system still faces a projected $100 million deficit.

stories.title: Buffalo Police commissioner credits Intelligence Unit work in recent guns, drugs, money seizures
stories.summary: Commissioner Erika Shields also responded as the police union president has raised more questions over police staffing.

stories.title: Celebrating the 'Bills Cafe' in Cheektowaga
stories.summary: Diehard group travels (and parties) to watch the Bills on the road.

stories.title: Orchard Park approves new zoning district near Highmark Stadium
stories.summary: The new Gateway Mixed Use district allows buildings up to five stories, along with hotels, restaurants and offices near Highmark Stadium.

stories.title: City of Lockport Police seek help finding missing 33-year-old man
stories.summary: Police said Borner has gone extended periods without contacting his family before, but he typically checks in after a few months.

stories.title: Police in Buffalo, North Tonawanda search for missing teen
stories.summary: Mya Scott, 14, was reported missing out of Buffalo. She was last seen on Garner Avenue.
